notes.title: Red Bow Set For The Steam Release January 17th (Multiple Languages Included)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/9b05aab91542d6fe120a74c02c22f610fdd09da2.jpg[/img]

We are very happy to announce the full release of Red Bow!

[h1]Wishlist/Follow on Steam[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/710600/Red_Bow/

[h1]STORY[/h1]
If you were given another chance, would you take it? Or leave it in the hands of a little girl?
Play as Roh, a young girl stuck in a bizarre nightmare of dark and eerie creatures.

[h1]GAMEPLAY[/h1]
This short game will have you entangled with its story-driven narrative and puzzles as you help Roh find an answer to her place in this strange world. Red Bow is designed to play and feel as a modern top down Gameboy game with roughly 1 - 2 hours of game play with achievement hunting.

The game uses an RPG top-down style which consists of finding items, secrets and solving puzzles to progress the story. The game progresses in sequences which are filled with secrets and easter eggs! Find the multiple endings by following clues and your gut!

notes.title: UPDATE + Future for My Big Sister
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Just another small update addressing one particular bug and more grammatical corrections.

[b]Fixes:
Grammar
Lady on the wall face not appearing for achievement.[/b]


[h1]The future of My Big Sister[/h1]

I have been noticing that there have been quite afew complaints about the games playabllity. A lot of these issues are due to the game engine I developed MBS in. As hard as I try, I cannot solve every issue and I do apologize. But, I was thinking, if the game is well recieved I may make a definitive version in Unity! 

I have been working on a small series that I will be unvailing a teaser soon being developed in unity. And I would love to re-make My Big Sister in Unity! 

How will Unity enhance My Big Sister?

*Better collisions! The collision system will be greatly improved due to the fact 
 that the player won't just instantly stop if they hit a collision!

*Game cameras! 

*Aspect Ratios!

*Porting! (Maybe)

And many more benefits!

Please leave your thoughts! But like I mentioned, I possibly won't remake MBS unless it is well recieved. I'd rather use the time to create another story.

P.S If your save file has corupted due to this update you can eithe use the rollback version under bets in the game's steam properties or use the chapter cheat in the main menu of the game. Press [P] then "chapter#" # = 1 to 10

notes.title: UPDATE [Please Read!]
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

I would like to announce that the game is now complete with the last two endings added to the game. The catch is, I won't be giving hints on how to obtain it bar one!

[spoiler]All the clues you need are in the last chapter! Also, becareful where you smoke![/spoiler]


[h1]SAVE SYSTEM[/h1]

I have added a new save system to the game. The game will now state save at save points and auto save screens. This will save your exact progress throughout the game.

[h1]WARNING[/h1]

Your current save game will be corrupted and you wil have to start a new game for this feature to work! However, I have added a rollback method incase you want to finish your current save game first.

[h1]ROLLBACK GAME[/h1]

Go to your games properties in your steam library and click on builds. Use the dropbox menu to click on rollback. Your game will update and your old save will be there.

[h1]SO...WHAT NOW?[/h1]
Now we enter the proof reading and bug checking stage. If anyone finds something, please report it to the bug and grammar thread. 

Then it will just be spit and polish, ready for a Halloween release! 

Thank you every one for this amazing journey! And as always, please give me your thoughts!

notes.title: [CHAPTER UPDATE] Chapter 10 The Final Chapter!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I would like to announce that the Final Chapter to My Big Sister is here! I have also added some new achievements and a few secrets. So, what happens after this? Well, now comes the detailing, bug and grammar checking (please report if you find any in the bug/grammar thread), any extra music, translations, new save system and anything else I can think of. Also, I may add another ending to the game before full release depending on the feedback I recieve.

Please as always, leave you feedback and comments here for Chapter 10!

Thanks again for all your help!


EDIT: Fixed chapter 9 to chapter 10 bug!

notes.title: Update on Final Chapter!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Unfortunately the game/story is coming to an end :'(. But! Don't worry! I'll be starting on a new story game, once My Big Sister is done and dusted! 

Things will start to speed up this year, as I am giving full time game developing one last go. 

If you would like to help support me whilst I make more adventure games, please check out my Patreon! I post development updates, sneak peeks of future games, art work and maybe at some point spriting and AGS tutorials! I'll also be giving away free sprite assets to patreons each month to help them with there games! 

And all my patreons will be included in the game's credits! (even though there are only 2) :)

Check it out here:  [url]https://www.patreon.com/strangagames[/url]

Also, vote for what my next story game will be about: [url]https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/96F9X7Z[/url]

Chapter 10, is about %70 complete! We're almost there! Once all the chapters are complete, I will be fine tuning, bug testing and translating the game until release. 

I would like to thank everyone who supported the development process, and the community! Not only have you guys helped me create a good story adventure, but have also given me some great feedback to make my future games better!

Thank you everyone!



Stranga,

notes.title: Development Update (Sorry for the delay)
notes.notes:

I am going through the feedback from everyone including the reviews to try and improve the gameplay experience. 

Unfortunately this week I hat a major wall with my laptop finally dying on me and I have to purchase a new one. But don't fret! I will try and get a replacement in the next few days!

Also as a quick side note, I will be implementing a full save system upon official release which you will be able to save at anytime during the game (except cutscenes). The reason for the auto save function is purely to not corrupt player's save files if the game is updated.

I would also like anyone's opinion of the game so far if you wish to share it here :)

notes.title: Release date has been postpone to 23-24.
notes.notes:
I would like to apologize for having to postpone the release date due to steam's rules. Steam won't allow me to release the game on the 19th because the store page needs to be visible for 14 days prior to release. 

But don't worry! This will give us plenty of time to test the game over a few more times and add any bug fixes that are still hidden within the cracks.

I estimate the game should be ready by Jan 23-24. But it will be soon!
